<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { LabelProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

const props = defineProps<LabelProps>();

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Label text. Wrap a whole `Field` to turn it into a selectable card.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Label
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs }"
    data-slot="field-label"
    :class="cn(
      'group/field-label peer/field-label flex w-fit gap-2 leading-snug group-data-[disabled=true]/field:opacity-50',
      'has-[>[data-slot=field]]:w-full has-[>[data-slot=field]]:flex-col has-[>[data-slot=field]]:rounded-md has-[>[data-slot=field]]:border [&>*]:data-[slot=field]:p-4',
      'has-data-[state=checked]:border-primary has-data-[state=checked]:bg-primary/5 dark:has-data-[state=checked]:bg-primary/10',
      $attrs.class ?? '',
    )"
  >
    <slot />
  </Label>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

interface FieldLegendProps {
  /**
   * `legend` renders a section heading, `label` matches the size of a field label.
   */
  variant?: 'legend' | 'label';
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<FieldLegendProps>(), {
  variant: 'legend',
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Legend text of the `FieldSet`.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <legend
    v-bind="delegatedAttrs"
    data-slot="field-legend"
    :data-variant="props.variant"
    :class="cn('mb-3 font-medium data-[variant=label]:text-sm data-[variant=legend]:text-base', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot />
  </legend>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * A `FieldLegend`, an optional `FieldDescription`, and a `FieldGroup`.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <fieldset
    v-bind="delegatedAttrs"
    data-slot="field-set"
    :class="cn('flex flex-col gap-6 has-[>[data-slot=checkbox-group]]:gap-3 has-[>[data-slot=radio-group]]:gap-3', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot />
  </fieldset>
</template>
